reads.pagination: none — single settings object per user, no list

none — full list fetched at once, no page/cursor params, no infinite scroll. blockedAt is a pre-formatted display label in the mock (e.g. '3 weeks ago', '2 months ago'), not an ISO timestamp — UI never formats it, so the real endpoint's field shape (raw timestamp vs pre-formatted string) is an open reconciliation question. Also read by privacy/page.tsx solely for its .length to render a count badge next to the 'Blocked accounts' row.

actions.name: savePrivacySettings
actions.notes: Client sends the ENTIRE PrivacySettings object on every toggle (optimistic local flip of one key, then the whole object is PUT), not a single-field patch. Fire-and-forget: the UI does not await the response or reconcile against it (void savePrivacySettings(next)), and does not handle a save failure — if the write fails server-side the toggle stays visually flipped with no rollback/error UI.

actions.name: unblockAccount
actions.notes: Mock returns Promise<boolean> (always true) and the caller only uses success to splice the id out of local list state — response body has no other shape to reconcile against.

actions.name: requestDataExport
actions.notes: No parameters sent — implicitly scoped to the authenticated user. Mock resolves { requestedAt: ISOString }. This is an email-delivery request, not an in-browser file download: UI never receives/streams a file, it only shows a confirmation sheet stating the data will be emailed within 48 hours.

uiStatesDesigned.state: Privacy — toggles + Your data group (frame 3, 'WAWU Settings States.dc.html')
uiStatesDesigned.detail: Single steady-state frame: 'Show what I have bought' (off, with 'nobody sees your purchases' caption), 'Show my saved items' (off, no caption in design vs code which also has none), 'Show who I follow' (on), Communities group 'Show me in member lists' (on, with 'messages are visible either way' caption), then a Your-data group of three ListRows — Blocked accounts (meta='2'), Download my data (subtitle 'Sent to your email'), Privacy policy (trailing='external') — plus the BVN/NIN reassurance footer. Matches the code's default MOCK_PRIVACY_SETTINGS values and row structure closely.

uiStatesDesigned.state: Global Empty / Error / Offline / 404 (frame 7, generic app-wide states, same file)
uiStatesDesigned.detail: Frame 7 shows a generic EmptyState/ErrorState/Offline-banner/404 pattern shared across the app (its Empty example is captioned for the Saved screen, not privacy/blocked specifically) — no privacy- or blocked-accounts-specific loading/error/empty frame exists in the design file. The code's blocked:empty ('No blocked accounts') and privacy:error/blocked:error ErrorState usage follow this generic pattern but have no screen-specific design frame of their own.

designNotes: No frame in 'WAWU Settings States.dc.html' (or elsewhere in design/screens/*.dc.html) depicts the Blocked-accounts list screen itself (loaded/empty/error), the data-export confirm/loading/success/error sheet sequence, or the static Privacy-policy page — only the top-level Privacy toggle screen (frame 3) and the app-wide generic states (frame 7) are designed. These three gaps are not fabricated as designed states above.
